summary.zh: 分析用户输入的岗位描述和明确选择的本地业务材料，识别SAP岗位、流程和日常操作，并匹配现有Agent、组合工作流或能力缺口。
summary.en: Analyzes user-provided role descriptions and explicitly selected local business documents, identifies SAP roles, processes and daily operations, and maps them to agents, composed workflows, or capability gaps.

zh: 岗位描述文字和/或本地文件或目录路径
多轮补充材料与业务反馈
en: Role description text and/or local file or directory paths
Multi-turn supplemental material and business feedback

zh: 带来源引用的分析报告
只读取用户明确输入的描述和选择的路径
用户描述与正式文档来源分开标记
不执行宏、公式、外部链接或嵌入代码
正文仅保存在本机.local-data目录
不修改原始文档、SAP数据、Agent或工作流
en: Reads only descriptions entered and paths selected by the user
Keeps user descriptions distinct from formal document sources
Does not execute macros, formulas, external links, or embedded code
Source text remains under the local .local-data directory
Does not modify source documents, SAP data, agents, or workflows

description.zh: 接收岗位描述和/或安全扫描用户指定路径，形成带来源类型和位置引用的正文。
description.en: Accepts a role description and/or safely scans user-selected paths, producing text with source types and locators.

description.zh: 由Codex Runtime理解SAP业务操作，再由平台复核Agent与工作流建议。
description.en: Codex Runtime understands SAP operations, then the platform verifies agent and workflow suggestions.

purpose.zh: 形成结构化业务理解和候选匹配
purpose.en: Produces structured business understanding and candidate matches

description.zh: 用户可增量补充材料或全量重算，历史修订保持不可变。
description.en: Users can add materials incrementally or fully recompute while prior revisions remain immutable.

purpose.zh: 保存修订、来源和完整性
